rows.note: Use this for repeated actions happening at set or predictable intervals.

example.english: We regularly go for health checkups.
example.traditional: 我哋定期去做身體檢查。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ding6 kei4 heoi3 zou6 san1 tai2 gim2 caa4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for “normally” or “ordinarily.”

example.english: I regularly take the bus to work.
example.jyutping: tung1 soeng4 ngo5 daap3 baa1 si6 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this for what someone normally does in everyday life, especially in contrast with a special occasion or the present situation.

example.english: I regularly wear sneakers, and only wear leather shoes to work.
example.traditional: 平時我着波鞋，返工先着皮鞋。
example.jyutping: ping4 si4 ngo5 zoek3 bo1 haai4 faan1 gung1 sin1 zoek3 pei4 haai4
